newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGRICULTURAL BANK Q1 PROFIT 11.24 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK Q1 PROFIT 11.24 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's state-run Agricultural Bank said on Thursday that its net profit for the first quarter of 1997 was 11.24 million litas.
"The bank ended the first quarter of the year with a net profit of 11.24 million litas," the bank's spokeswoman, Imandra Daukshiene, told Reuters.

She added that the bank could not provide a comparative figure because its first quarter results for 1996 were based on Lithuanian accounting standards while this year's profit figure was calculated on the basis of international standards.
The bank's net profit for 1996 was 25.5 million litas.
Daukshiene also said that the assets of the bank were 1.24 billion litas at the end of March compared to 1.297 billion litas at the beginning of the year.
The loan portfolio of the bank dipped slightly to 1.06 billion litas at the end of March versus 1.08 billion litas at the start of the year, Daukshiene said.
Deposits also fell, dropping to 1.09 billion litas at the end of March compared to 1.12 billion litas at the beginning of 1997, she added.
The bank, the largest in the country in terms of assets, has been slated for privatisation.
